data.name: Gopal
data.gender_notes: Gopal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: One who protects cows and all beings
data.long_meaning: Gopala means 'one who protects cows and all beings'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Krishna is often referred to as Gopal, the protector of the Gopas (cowherds) and their cows. This name is a symbol of compassion, love, and protection. The name Gopal carries the meaning “One who protects cows and all beings” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Gopal usually hope their child will grow to embody one who protects cows and all beings and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Gopal represents the divine protection and care offered by the Lord, encouraging us to embrace our spirituality and connect with the divine.
data.etymology: Gopal belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who protects cows and all beings.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gopal total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: Gopal is a name deeply rooted in Hindu culture, particularly associated with the childhood stories of Lord Krishna. The name acknowledges the respect and significance given to the occupation of cowherding in Hindu tradition. In some communities, the term 'Gopal' is also used as a title or title of respect for individuals who take care of cows or other living beings, embodying the values of compassion, love, and care.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the name Gopal holds profound spiritual significance as it signifies the divine being who protects, nurtures, and cares for all creation, just as a cowherd protects his herd. This name is a reminder of the importance of compassion and love, not just towards cows and animals, but towards all beings. Gopal is believed to be a manifestation of Lord Vishnu, representing the power of love and preservation. This name is an inspiration for individuals to embody the qualities of love, compassion, and protection towards others, ultimately helping to create a harmonious and compassionate society.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Gopal, meaning 'Protector of Cows and People', embodies the selfless love and care of Krishna towards his community. Symbolizing a divine guardian, Gopal's name transcends material wealth as he is known to watch over and nurture both the physical and spiritual well-being of all beings.

vedic_reference.note: Gopal is a name of Lord Krishna, who is known as the protector of cows.

historical_references.reference: Gopal is a name of the Hindu god Krishna, who is often depicted as the protector of cows and their calves.
historical_references.context: Gopal is an epithet of Krishna, indicating his role as the protector of the cowherds and their livestock. This reference comes from Krishna's childhood years spent in Vrindavan, where he was known to wander the forests with the cowherds, protecting their cattle.

historical_references.reference: The name 'Gopal' is also used as a personal name in Hindu communities and translates to 'cowherd' or 'protector of cows'.
historical_references.context: The use of the name 'Gopal' as a personal name is a reflection of Krishna's significance as a protector of cows and livestock, as well as the importance of cow protection in Hindu culture. The name 'Gopal' continues to be used as a common name throughout India and Nepal.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Gopal' is derived from the Hindu deity name 'Govinda' and translates to 'one who protects or nourishes'. This name is popularly used across various platforms such as Instagram, LinkedIn, and WhatsApp. On Instagram, #Gopal is used in posts related to Hindu culture, art, and spirituality. On LinkedIn, it's used as a name by individuals in their professional profiles. And on WhatsApp, it's used as a name for children and pets. Overall, the name 'Gopal' is seen as a symbol of protection, nourishment, and love.

name_in_real_life.story: Anita Gopal from Kolkata, India embodies the meaning of Gopal - "One who protects cows and all beings". Growing up in a Hindu family, they were taught to honor the spiritual significance of their name and live according to dharma.
